channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Nov 23
item.description:
224 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Fixed procedural spawn overlap issues, preventing trees, ore nodes, junkpiles, etc., from intersecting and allowing seagull groups to spawn correctly.
  • Closing the premium window now also closes the skin viewer, preventing it from staying open unintentionally.
  • Each character slot in the creator retains its own underwear selection, so changes in one slot no longer affect others.
  • Choosing a body type without underwear parts no longer results in a naked character.
  • The facial hair tab becomes active immediately after changing the body type, speeding up appearance customization.

Movement & Controls

  • Added configurable sprint movement, now player‑controlled via in‑game settings.
  • Improved dog commands: better heel command and dogs now match player speed, making handling smoother.

NPC & AI

  • Overhauled scientist AI with replay‑based aim, accurate after crouch‑hovering, and fixes for hovering, rotation, and door‑search bugs, resulting in reliable targeting and movement.

World & Environment

  • Fishing villages now spawn at safer distances from river mouths, reducing clutter.
  • Sprinklers no longer wet players through floors or ceilings, preventing unexpected wetness.
  • Fixed procedural spawn overlap issues, preventing trees, ore nodes, junkpiles, etc., from intersecting and allowing seagull groups to spawn correctly.

Vehicles & Transport

  • Added M939 Truck at Excavator Monument, providing a new transport option.
  • Fixed car repel force so it triggers correctly when an animal is exactly at the repelling position.

Building, Items & Livestock

  • Deployables now follow split‑off base parts when they are moved, staying with the new structure.
  • Dropping items on thin surfaces (e.g., oil‑rig floors) works reliably without line‑of‑sight blockage.
  • Livestock can be renamed instantly, removing the previous delay.

Missions & Respawn

  • Items stored in backpacks now count toward mission progress.
  • Sleeping bags can be placed adjacent and no longer get stuck on respawn, improving respawn reliability.

Quality of Life

  • Closing the premium window now also closes the skin viewer, preventing it from staying open unintentionally.
  • Each character slot in the creator retains its own underwear selection, so changes in one slot no longer affect others.
  • Choosing a body type without underwear parts no longer results in a naked character.
  • The facial hair tab becomes active immediately after changing the body type, speeding up appearance customization.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Mission item dispensers now correctly dispense items and track objectives, fixing progression issues.
  • Item drop blockage bug fixed, ensuring items drop normally from containers and entities.
  • Extraction UI now shows a large label, whole-number percentage and thick orange bar for hold progress.
  • Mortar weapon hands now correctly follow pitch, fixing lagging animation.
  • Sprinkler wet floor effect fixed, preventing unintended slipping.
  • M939 truck added to Mining Quarry monuments, providing a new vehicle spawn location.
  • M939 truck added to Gas Station monument (HLOD updated).
  • Freight lift prototype introduced in exit test scene as a team-wide exit option (WIP).

World Generation

  • Cave generation now respects monument topology, preventing caves from overlapping monument entrances.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Nov 22
item.description:
121 development commits

Map Layout

  • Monuments are arranged in eccentric rings with the endgame core offset to one side; the Power Plant sits centrally, core monuments lean inward and are anchored to specific rings.
  • The first closing balloon is placed in the outer ring, away from hatches.

AI & Reinforcements

  • Tier‑2 monuments now host gunner drones that fire pistol rounds with recoil.
  • Core monuments are guarded by AI; when their guards are depleted helicopters can deliver reinforcements and a Bradley patrols the core area, and players receive warnings near monuments and before a balloon closes.

Economy & Pricing

  • Backpack sale price is fixed at 400 after completing Missing Shipment, and loot items have fixed rarity‑based pricing that no longer varies with colour.
  • Item values are calculated from supply stock and a fixed shop list (bandit camp excluded); gold‑floor items, condition‑scaled sales and blueprint prices are defined without bandit influence, the safe pocket only accepts non‑weapon/armour items and values them as the shop would pay, and the shop now buys only finished goods while components are sent to a recycler for a refund.

Inventory & Loot

  • Stash capacity increased by two rows at a time up to a maximum of 96 slots.
  • Low‑tier crates and barrels now contain fewer tools and weapons, and junk‑pile crates no longer include ring parts.

Raid & Extraction

  • Extraction balloons no longer carry a secondary hot‑air balloon; escape hatches can be opened with a Cobalt bypass card; outer‑ring crates now have a rare jackpot chance; and raid duration is extended to 35 minutes.
  • Raid reset now removes player‑placed structures along with their contents.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Improved beach spawn locations reduce clustering and give more reliable initial placement.
  • Fishing vendor updates add new bait options and adjust pricing for better resource management.
  • Fixed overlapping train tunnel geometry, preventing players from getting stuck or falling through tunnels.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Nov 21
item.description:
68 development commits

NPC & AI

  • Fixed lambs getting stuck and failing to follow a sprinting player when led.
  • Scout NPCs that become trapped against signs or poles now automatically free themselves.

Monuments & World

  • Monument guard NPCs now spread out, scale with monument size, and can stand on any floor.
  • Raid maps now spawn only whitelisted monuments, with each tier‑1 monument appearing once per map.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Stash UI no longer repeats the bank balance, showing the correct amount only.
  • Bank balance is now always displayed on the Outpost screen for continuous fund monitoring.
